  sources:

    - name: AuthApi

        openapi:

          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: Bearer {context.jwt}
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
  transforms:
    - filterSchema:
        filters:

    - rename:

          - from:

              field: getProduct
            to:

              field: product
  plugins:
    - useResponseCache:
        ttl: 60000
    - prometheus:
        endpoint: /metrics

    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true

          source: ./specs/media.yaml

            Authorization: Bearer {context.jwt}
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
    - name: RegistryApi
      handler:
        openapi:
          source: ./specs/registry.yaml
          operationHeaders:
            Authorization: Bearer {context.jwt}
            X-Request-ID: '{context.requestId}'
  transforms:
    - filterSchema:
        filters:
          - Query.!*_internal
    - rename:
        renames:
          - from:
              type: Query
              field: getMedia
            to:
              type: Query
              field: media
  plugins:
    - useResponseCache:
        ttl: 60000
    - prometheus:
        endpoint: /metrics
  serve:
    endpoint: /graphql
    playground: true
  mockSwitch:
    enabled: true
